lines: What is VidyaSeva Scholarship for Girls Students ?
which was started for Disaster Relief in May 2020,has successfully expanded to non-disaster relief initiatives as well and has also reached out to more than 3000 undeserved families since.
is an attempt to empower girls from poor families by supporting them in their pursuit to lead to a future of equality & dignity.
Only for girls Students studying from Class 8-Class 12
Students from all States of India can apply
The Students must have scored more than 60% marks in the previous class.
The annual family income must be less than INR 6000 per month or 72000 per year
Single Parents Students and Differently Abled Students will be given a preference.
Scholarship will be Renewed Every Year Incase of good percentage achieved by Student
Click on Matching Scholarship Section and Click on VidyaSeva Scholarship
